name: NSSF CON5 Monthly Contribution - Online Version
query:
SELECT 
    emp.tin AS "EMPLOYEE'S TIN:Data:150",
    emp.employment_type AS "TYPE OF EMPLOYMENT:Data:150",
    emp.custom_residential_status AS "RESIDENTIAL STATUS:Data:150",
    TRIM(CONCAT(emp.first_name, ' ', IFNULL(emp.middle_name, ''), ' ', emp.last_name)) AS "NAME OF EMPLOYEE:Data:250",
    emp.pension_fund_number AS "SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER:Data:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield = 'earnings' AND sd.salary_component = 'Basic' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS "BASIC PAY:Float/2:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield = 'deductions' AND sd.salary_component = 'NSSF Employer' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS "NSSF EMPLOYER:Float/2:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield = 'deductions' AND sd.salary_component = 'NSSF' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS "NSSF EMPLOYEE:Float/2:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield = 'deductions' AND UPPER(TRIM(sd.salary_component)) LIKE '%%PAYE%%' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS "PAYE:Float/2:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield = 'deductions' AND sd.salary_component = 'WCF' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS "WCF:Float/2:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield = 'deductions' AND sd.salary_component = 'SDL' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS "SDL:Float/2:150"
FROM `tabSalary Slip` ss 
INNER JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON ss.employee = emp.name 
LEFT JOIN `tabSalary Detail` sd ON sd.parent = ss.name
WHERE ss.docstatus = 1 
  AND ss.start_date >= %(from_date)s
  AND ss.end_date <= %(to_date)s
GROUP BY ss.name, emp.name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN sd.parentfield = 'deductions' AND sd.salary_component = 'NSSF' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY emp.name
report_name: NSSF CON5 Monthly Contribution - Online Version
